SSEI · Offline branding · Leadership brief · 13 October 2026

Mumbai OOH Plan

Ride the city on BEST buses. Own the bus stops at the gates of Mumbai's top commerce colleges. Show up where finance works. A ₹10 lakh plan built from our Mumbai recce and two vendor quotes.

Every rupee on this page is a first-round vendor quote, not a negotiated price. Both vendors shared these after one discussion. The final cost depends on which priorities we lock and how many sites and months we commit to. All figures are for 30 days and exclude 18% GST.

01 · From the Mumbai recce

Mumbai does not run on hoardings. It runs on buses and trains.

1billboard in a 29-line plan

Static hoardings are rare

Cityscapes' whole Mumbai plan holds one billboard, and it is LED. GC Media's 336-line list has two hoardings, both in Navi Mumbai. The city's roadside inventory is bus shelters.

1/6of the screen time on LED

LED costs more and shows us less

On LED shelters and billboards our ad is one 10-second slot in every 60-second loop. A ₹2.05 L LED shelter shows our ad for one-sixth of its running hours.

2education brands seen on BEST buses

Our competitors already ride the buses

Zell Education and JK Shah Classes run full BEST bus wraps. A bus crosses many neighbourhoods a day, so 20 buses reach far more of the city than 5 fixed sites.

3coaching brands on the vendor's own train photos

Local trains are crowded with education ads

The vendor's sample train photos show Allen, Parul University and Atharva University. Trains give reach, but we would be one more coaching ad in a queue. That is why trains are priority 4.

~60%aided recall in Kolkata

Kolkata taught us: one bold line wins

Three static sites with one bold line reached about 60% aided recall among students we surveyed, and 80%+ outside St. Xavier's. Leads stayed flat, so OOH builds recall and we measure it that way.

02 · The idea

Four priorities, in this order

We only buy media that touches finance: commerce students at their college gates, and working professionals in the business districts. No residential or leisure locations.

03 · The map

One college hub in every zone. Our picks are numbered.

Each colour is a zone of Mumbai. Tap a blue circle to see the colleges there and what we would buy next to them. The red numbers match the rows in the ₹10 L plan.

Pins are placed by us from each site's landmark, accurate to about 300 m. Neither vendor shared GPS.

04 · Why buses come first

20 buses cost the same as 5 LED shelters

Same vendor, same 30 days, quoted rates. A bus carries our line across the city all day. A shelter waits for people to come to it.

What about ₹10 L buys for 30 days

Cityscapes first-round rates, before GST
20 EV buses: ₹11.1 L. Five LED bus shelters: ₹10.25 L. Twenty moving ads against five fixed screens we share with five other brands.

Cost of being seen all day, every day

30-day cost of one face that shows only our ad. LED faces are multiplied by 6 because we get one slot in six.
A non-lit college shelter costs ₹30,920. Full-time presence on an LED shelter costs the equivalent of ₹12.3 L.

Lead vendor: Cityscapes

Only vendor offering BEST buses, has the college gates and trains, and is cheaper on non-lit shelters. Ask them to drop the LED lines and the three off-brief LED sites (Juhu Beach, Carter Road, Dadar market, ₹6.45 L).

Specialist: GC Media

Use for BKC and Powai, where Cityscapes has nothing static. Share our brief with them and ask for a matched plan. Their quote says rates are negotiable once sites are confirmed, which gives us leverage on both.

06 · The ₹10 L plan

How we would spend it

Three versions at the same ₹10 L, before GST. Every line below is a real quoted site. The numbers are the red pins on the map; click a name to jump to it.

MapPriorityWhatVendorZone30 days, before GST
Month 2 is cheap for buses. The ₹15,000 per bus print cost is paid once. Keeping the same 10 buses for a second month costs ₹4.05 L at quoted rates (₹3.24 L at our target), with no reprint. That is the strongest extension if December reads well.
07 · When

Sign off this week, go live on 1 December

Students are back

December is after semester exams and the Diwali break. College gates are busy again. To confirm against this year's Mumbai University calendar.

Off-peak for OOH

Navratri to Diwali is the busiest outdoor season. Booking for December gives us better sites and a stronger hand in round two.

Time to do it right

Six weeks covers negotiation, a physical check of every shortlisted site, creative, printing and BEST's approval of the bus artwork.

09 · Creative direction

One line. Big logo. Local to the street.

Students give an ad about two seconds. We drop the faculty photo and the list of courses and write one line that only makes sense at that spot. These lines are a brief for the design team, not final copy.

BEST EV bus, side panel
Shelter panel, Thakur Village
8 words or fewerOne line, one idea. If it needs a second sentence, it is a brochure.
QR only where people waitShelters and platforms, yes. Moving buses, never. Nobody scans a bus.
Say the placeName the street, the station or the college belt. Local lines get noticed and shared.
Bold, not personalKolkata's bold line worked. The pushback was about attaching a person's name, not about boldness. Lead with SSEI.
10 · What we need

Decisions and next steps

From leadership, this week

  1. Approve ₹10 L before GST (₹11.8 L with GST) for a 30-day Mumbai campaign.
  2. Approve the Balanced plan as the starting point for round two.
  3. Approve Cityscapes as lead, GC Media for BKC and Powai.
  4. Approve a 1 December start.
  5. Pre-approve month 2 for buses (₹4.05 L) if the week-3 read is positive.

Round two with Cityscapes

  • BEST route and depot list for the 10 buses. We want routes through Churchgate, Matunga, BKC, Vile Parle, Thakur Village and Vidyavihar.
  • Current photos. Most static shelter photos are stamped 2020 to 2021.
  • GPS for every site.
  • A static face at the Mithibai and NM College shelters instead of LED.
  • Shelters at Vidyavihar, Ghatkopar and Lower Parel. None were quoted.
  • A rate for 10 to 20 buses over 60 days.

Round two with GC Media

  • Share our brief and ask for a matched plan, not a rate card.
  • Hold the MTNL Exchange shelter in BKC and price the Powai Hiranandani shelters.
  • Define "AL" lighting, and confirm whether the Dadar and Vile Parle platform line is one board or five.
  • Real photos for each shelter. All shelter photos are reference pictures.
  • Remove the 15 Navi Mumbai sites (₹12.2 L).
  • Ask whether they can offer BEST bus branding.

Sources. Cityscapes, "SSEI Mumbai OOH Proposal 13.10.2026" (xlsx and deck). GC Media, "SSEI MH Media Plan" (xlsx and deck). SSEI Mumbai trip photos, October 2026. Kolkata OOH student study, August 2026. Scholarship campaign conversion report, August 2026 (average ticket and 3.0x new-buyer return).

Method. Prices are copied from the vendor sheets: display + printing + installation, 30 days, before 18% GST. Neither vendor supplied coordinates (GC's deck has one map link), so SSEI placed each pin from the landmark in the site name. College lists are SSEI's selection of leading commerce and management colleges by area. The "target" scenario assumes 20% off display rates, which is a negotiating goal, not an offer.
